name: Wispmail
tagline: Temporary email (temp mail) — receive one-time emails without signing up.
description: Wispmail gives you an instant disposable email address in seconds. Use it to sign up for services, verify accounts, or avoid spam in your real inbox. Emails auto-expire, no registration needed, and everything stays on your device.
features: No sign-up or personal info required
changelog: Instant disposable email, no registration required
